evidence.title: AutoSaddler: Automatic Harness Optimization with Durable Updates from Agent Execution Traces

summary: AutoSaddler presents a new AI-driven method for optimizing test harnesses by leveraging durable updates from agent execution traces. The approach aims to improve software testing efficiency and reliability through automated adjustments.
title: AutoSaddler Introduces AI-Powered Automatic Harness Optimization Using Execution Traces
